newsitems.title: PUBG EMEA CHAMPIONSHIP & PUBG AMERICAS SERIES RETURNS
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]PEC: Fall and PAS2 returns to give teams from across EMEA and Americas the opportunity to prove themselves and compete for a chance to earn PGC Points to qualify for the PUBG Global Championship 2026 in Istanbul, Türkiye. With so much on the line, we hope you are as excited as we are for the tournament to kick off.[/p][p]Whether you are an established roster or an up-and-coming squad looking to make your mark, this is your chance to compete against the region's best and begin or continue your journey to PGC.[/p][h2][b]Get ready to register[/b][/h2][p]Registration for PEC: Fall and PAS2 opens on July 13th.[/p][p]Be sure to mark your calendar and get your squad ready to compete. With valuable PGC Points on the line and a chance to prove yourselves against the best teams in EMEA and Americas, you won't want to miss your opportunity to enter.[/p][h2][b]Tournament Schedule [/b][/h2][p]Just like in the previous regional series, PEC: Fall and PAS2 will follow the same tournament structure, beginning with open registration before five weeks of Scrims and Open Cups lead into the Playoffs and Finals. Check out the full schedule below and make sure to mark the key dates in your calendar.[/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260702/1oBPA5Ie.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][h2][b]Stay connected and up to date[/b][/h2][p]Follow PUBG Esports on social media to stay up to date with tournament news, schedules, broadcast announcements, and everything you need to know throughout PEC: Fall & PAS2. [/p][p][/p][p]Instagram: [url="http://instagram.com/pubgesports"]@PUBGEsports[/url][/p][p]X: [url="https://x.com/PUBGEsports"]@PUBGEsports[/url][/p][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@pubg.esports.official"]@pubg.esports.official[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: PUBG Saturday Custom Games return this weekend!
newsitems.author: TecK
newsitems.contents:
[p]The next edition of [b]PUBG Saturday Custom Games[/b] is happening this [b]Saturday, July 4th at 20:00 CEST[/b], bringing the community together once again for custom matches, creator co-streams, and G-Coin giveaways.[/p][p][b]Tune in live on Twitch:[/b] [/p][p]Join the games, squad up with the community, and follow the broadcast for your chance to win rewards throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]G-Coin Giveaways[/b][/h3][p]During this month’s event, players will have the chance to win:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main broadcast raffle[/b]
10x 1,000 G-Coin codes[/p][p][/p][p][b]Creator giveaways[/b]
5x 500 G-Coin codes per participating co-streaming creator[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you are jumping into the custom games or watching along with your favorite creators, there will be plenty of chances to get involved.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye on the official [url="http://discord.gg/Battlegrounds"]PUBG Discord[/url], the [url="https://www.twitch.tv/jorosar"]Twitch broadcast[/url], and participating creator channels for lobby details, event updates, and giveaway information.[/p][p]
See you on the Battlegrounds this Saturday![/p]

newsitems.title: It All Comes Down To This - PNC 2026 Finals Day 3
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]After an Intense Survival Stage, the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 Grand Finals Are Here! - Day 3[/b][/h2][p]PNC 2026 will take place from June 23rd to June 28th in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Across five days of competition, 24 teams will battle for national pride and a share of the $500,000 base prize pool, further boosted by crowdfunding.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Grand Finals Participants[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p]Vietnam[/p][/td][td][p]China[/p][/td][td][p]Thailand[/p][/td][td][p]United States[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Germany[/p][/td][td][p]Brazil[/p][/td][td][p]Indonesia[/p][/td][td][p]Korea[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Ukraine[/p][/td][td][p]Turkiye[/p][/td][td][p]Denmark[/p][/td][td][p]Argentina[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]United Kingdom[/p][/td][td][p]Philippines[/p][/td][td][p]Neutral[/p][/td][td][p]Finland[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]PNC 2026 will be played across two stages — the Survival Stage and the Grand Finals — with 5 matches per day.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: 2 days / 10 matches total[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 3 days / 15 matches total[/p][/*][/list][p]Of the 24 competing teams, the top 8 from PNC 2025 will begin their journey directly in the Grand Finals, while the remaining 16 teams will battle for 8 Grand Finals slots during the Survival Stage.
[/p][h3][b]\[Grand Finals – 8 Teams][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Defending Champion: Vietnam[/p][/*][*][p]Brazil, China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand, United States of America[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Survival Stage – 16 Teams][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, India, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 8 teams from the Survival Stage will join the Grand Finals to form a final field of 16 teams. The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[Map Order][/b][/h3][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bd0815559ef03e5beb34d5ca61f38940314d9b73.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Event Schedule[/b][/h3][list][*][p]PNC 2026 Grand Finals Live Broadcast[/p][/*][*][p]June 26 (Fri) - June 28 (Sun), Matches start at 10:00 UTC[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Event Platforms[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Twitch[/p][/*][*][p]Kick[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Requirements & Rewards[/b][/h3][p]Grand Finals DAY 1[/p][list][*][p]15 Minutes: PNC 2026 Victory (Spray)[/p][/*][*][p]30 Minutes: PNC 2026 Logo (Emblem)[/p][/*][/list][p] Grand Finals DAY 2[/p][list][*][p]15 Minutes: PNC 2026 Home Run (Spray)[/p][/*][*][p]30 Minutes: PNC 2026 Logo (Emblem)[/p][/*][/list][p] Grand Finals DAY 3[/p][list][*][p]15 Minutes: PNC 2026 Victory (Spray)[/p][/*][*][p]30 Minutes: PNC 2026 Home Run (Spray)[/p][/*][*][p]60 Minutes: PNC 2026 Logo (Emblem)[/p][/*][*][p]90 Minutes: PNC 2026 Jacket[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Notes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Drops can only be received on the designated streaming platforms (Twitch, Kick).[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards will not be granted after the specified Drops period ends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]KRAFTON ID[/b] is required to receive rewards, and it must be linked to both your game platform account and the respective streaming platform account. (See below for linking instructions.)[/p][/*][*][p]Drops rewards can only be claimed [b]1 time per account[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Campaign details may differ by platform, so please check the announcements on each channel.[/p][/*][*][p]Console players can only receive rewards through Twitch/Kick Drops, and rewards will be available after the live update. [/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: PNC 2026 × Thug Club: The Look of Victory
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/75d1378d95837463827a623e46852a63f8d1b830.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ad779a55684c696a521cfde6ed50c9ef832d3e39.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5a0fecc655d086331c285e6f494ea919441a380f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]PUBG Esports joins forces with Thug Club, the Seoul-based streetwear brand shaking up the global subculture scene, to present a very special collaboration.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]This is the [b]"Champions Look"[/b]—a one-of-a-kind creation permitted only to the single team that will ultimately lift the trophy at the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]The Road to Champion
[/b]The path to the pinnacle of PNC 2026 is by no means easy. With 24 teams clashing, players must fight through five days of fierce survival competition—spanning from the Survival Stage to the Grand Finals—to reach the sole ultimate throne. Only the single team that survives until the very end will grasp the honor of becoming the PNC Champion.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Earned, Not Given
[/b]The "PNC 2026 × Thug Club" collection will not be sold anywhere. It exists solely and exclusively for the exact moment the new champion of PNC 2026 is born.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] At the end of this grueling battle for survival, which team will conquer the challenge and claim the Champions Look?[/p]

The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[Map Order][/b][/h3][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Competitive Settings Update][/b][/h3][p]To deliver a more compact and fast-paced match flow, PNC 2026 will be played with adjusted Blue Zone settings.[/p][list][*][p]Shorter early Blue Zone phases: reduced duration for Phases 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter final Blue Zone phase: reduced duration for Phase 9[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of Land Ratio option: Land Ratio option has been disabled for Phases 4 and 8[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted circle size: overall reduction in circle radius to match the shorter match length[/p][/*][/list][p]These adjustments will apply to the PNC 2026 competitive environment and are expected to deliver an even more dynamic and exciting match flow.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Prize Pool & Crowdfunding[/b][/h3][p]PNC 2026 kicks off with a base prize pool of $500,000. 25% of the revenue from the PNC 2026 Event Pass, set to launch alongside the tournament, will be added to the total prize pool through crowdfunding, helping make PNC 2026 an even more rewarding stage for all participating teams.
[/p][p]The total prize pool will be distributed according to each team's final ranking, and both the prize money and sales revenue share will be distributed equally among each team's roster. Further details on the Event Pass, including release schedule and lineup, will be shared in a separate announcement.
[/p][p]* The Event Pass is not available on Console.
[/p][p]** However, 25% of the individual sales revenue from items included in the Event Pass will be added to the crowdfunding total in the same manner.
[/p]

newsitems.title: PNC 2026: Pride & Glory
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents:
[p][b][i]PNC 2026 is about to kick off! Here’s what you need to know about the top contenders, according to guest columnist and caster Jisuboy.[/i][/b][/p][p]Team pride and honor are on the line. For the users who enjoy PUBG and the viewers who love esports, wouldn't this be considered the most special moment of the year? The PUBG Nations Cup (hereafter PNC), which began at Jangchung Arena in 2019, is looking ahead to its 6th edition this year. This PNC 2026 will feature a total of 24 teams and is expected to be the biggest and most special event yet. And at the center of it all, many of you must be wondering which team will ultimately lift the trophy.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, let's take a look at the most likely championship contenders for PNC 2026.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/CHvdpneA.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Natus Vincere Assemble - Ukraine][/b][/p][p]The comrades who parted ways in the past have returned and reunited. In the past, when Hakatory was heavily dominating in international tournaments, there was the formidable backup fire of someone who was keeping their eyes wide open. Many players fell to their knees before them. However, unfortunately they couldn't ultimately secure a championship, leading them to part ways and walk their own paths. Quite some time has passed, and they have reunited as the representatives of the Ukraine team for PNC 2026. The joining of DIFX, who used to be the reliable turret for Natus Vincere (hereafter NAVI), can be considered the strongest imaginable combination for Ukraine. [/p][p]It is no exaggeration to say that Ukraine’s roster is practically NAVI itself. There are already three players from NAVI, and DIFX has a history of building synergy with NAVI for a long time. If Feyerist takes charge of the overall macro and team direction, Hakatory and boost1k will stand at the very front to shake up enemy lines, while DIFX operates the match by providing support fire from the back. Because the individual mechanics of the players are excellent, they mostly engage in gunfights that rely on raw aim, and their win rate is incredibly high.[/p][p]In particular, Hakatory, who secured the "Man of the Match" title 9 times in the 2026 PGS and firmly established himself as the undisputed best fragger in the world, has quite good synergy with the rising rookie fragger, boost1k. In this PNC 2026 as well, when a scenario arises where these two are dominating, if DIFX fills in the empty gaps, it naturally makes you wonder: who could possibly beat this team?[/p][p]Of course, as I have repeatedly mentioned in previous columns, their greatest weakness is their squad preservation. When analyzing the metrics of the 2026 PGS, if there is one glaring aspect about NAVI, it is that their revival count is extremely low. Across 70 Final Stage matches, they recorded a total of 52 revives, averaging 0.74 per match, showing poor resilience. This means that when a team fight breaks out, their combat power leakage is severe. The average revival count of the teams that won the 2026 PGS was 1.52 per match; compared to that, their figure drops to almost half. If opponents specifically target the moments when Ukraine's knock feed pops up, they can force them to fail their recovery and collapse.[/p][p][b]ACE - Hakatory
[/b]The number one candidate for the World's Best Gunner. From 2025 to now, it is safe to say almost no one can match his offensive power. Even the Emperor of Europe, xmpl, has to take a backseat; his gunplay alone is top-tier. However, because he is as fiery as his shots, his body often pushes too far forward, resulting in frequent early eliminations. Since Thailand's Best Gunner, KISS, has recently leveled up his weight class, a head-to-head clash between the two is highly anticipated.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/lOdRyOhG.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[USA][/b][/p][p]PNC 2024 was held in South Korea. The South Korean team won by a narrow margin, but the point difference at the time was exactly 1 point. If the Brazilian team hadn't kept them in check, South Korea's victory might not have happened. 10th place in 2019, 9th in 2022, 7th in 2023, runners-up in 2024, and 4th in 2025. This is the USA team.[/p][p]Looking at the main roster of the USA team, Shrimzy and Kickstart, who have consistently participated since 2022, stand out the most. Both have served as the main artillery for their team, Falcons, and they lack absolutely nothing in representing the USA team this time. Mid-to-long-range shooting is their specialty, and Shrimzy, in particular, has always shown great performances in international tournaments for many years, making him an undeniable target of caution.[/p][p]Born in 1993. The Professor. PurdyKurty, who holds the nickname "Professor," has taken the baton holder of the USA team since PNC 2024 and showcases solid macro in every match. Earning his nickname thanks to his precise grenade throwing abilities, if you evaluate him solely on throwing skills, he boasts a phenomenal level that ranks in the top five globally. He primarily uses a macro pattern of calmly occupying choke points and, once the grenade distance is reached, destroying the opposing team with throwables to seize the victory.[/p][p]It is no exaggeration to say that Cowboi, who was newly selected as a representative for the USA team this time, was chosen for his outstanding individual mechanics. His play of entering key strongholds of the battlefield first, holding out, and winning is remarkable. He enjoys the playstyle of constantly shaking up other teams from the front while receiving mid-to-long-range support fire from his teammates, and his value will soar to its peak in this very tournament.[/p][p]With overall good balance and a characteristic calmness, the USA team is expected to record a high placement in this PNC 2026 as well. If they aim for third-party events of other teams or slightly elevate their aggressive tendencies, I think they have enough power to fully aim for the championship this time.[/p][p][b]ACE - Shrimzy
[/b]If asked to pick just one player in the USA who is the most stable and consistent, Shrimzy is definitely the first to be chosen. He is great at infighting and boasts explosive firepower at mid-to-long ranges. However, compared to the performance he has shown on the international stage so far, he has been slightly shaky recently, so the key is how much his condition has recovered. I look forward to seeing if he can rebuild the faltering prestige of the USA team.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/jniUswwD.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The First Trophy - China][/b][/p][p]The Chinese team achieved their best result—runner-up—since participating in PNC last year, but even that probably wasn't satisfying for them. And understandably so, because the absolute elite members of the Chinese team were fully mobilized. This year, the one who rose to be the world's best (MMing) is gone, and the unprecedented genius (Aixleft) has also suddenly left. However, I can say that my prediction makes this the scariest Chinese representative team ever, and their chances of winning are higher than ever before.[/p][p]For a long time, many Chinese teams showed strength in the Asian region but often looked poor or inconsistent on the international stage. But there is a player who, based on years of international experience, has participated in almost every international tournament and delivered results. Not having a championship win on the international stage was the only flaw in his career, but he overcame even this by winning the PGS series. Now, the only tasks left for him are winning PNC and PGC. Who is it? It's the story of China's greatest commander, Lilghost.[/p][p]First of all, this player's judgment in taking good spots at the right timing and adjusting the pacing of defense is phenomenal. Because of this, all teams clearly know the methods he uses, yet cannot easily breach them. There are no openings. Even if they manage to create an opening and deal damage, Lilghost reinforces that very weakness in the next match. How can you fight against an opponent who unconditionally holds the upper hand in mind games?[/p][p]What about throwables? His team, 17Gaming, boasts world-class accuracy in throwing abilities. Grenades thrown together perfectly on time and dropping exactly in the right places bring down even impregnable fortresses. After weakening the enemy with precise throwables, they send in a general to dominate the battlefield. His teammate, xwudd, perfectly executes that role without hesitation.[/p][p]17Gaming's xwudd flaunted his skills not only in the regional tournament, PCL, but also by never backing down in any international tournament he participated in. Beyond mere individual mechanics, he is exceptional at reading the opponent's psychology, neutralizing countless fraggers. If you run into this player, you might as well abandon the thought of walking away unscathed. His close-quarters combat sense is innate, and you literally cannot beat him unless you risk everything. He can easily be called the Best Gunner of the Central Plains. He is a player who can personally prove why he was selected as a Chinese national representative for 3 consecutive years.[/p][p]With great overall macro, and joined by SpaceMan, the MVP of 2026 PGS1, the momentum of the Chinese team for this PNC 2026 is extraordinary. Furthermore, three of the Chinese representative players belong to the same team, 17Gaming, and since their coach, Akuma, is also taking the helm for the Chinese team, strategy formulation and player management are much smoother compared to other teams. The first PNC trophy is getting closer to the Chinese team.[/p][p][b]ACE - tiantian
[/b]Among the newly selected Chinese representatives this year, 17Gaming's tiantian, along with xwudd, can be picked as the most feared player. He claimed the final MVP in the regional PCL tournament this year and maintained top-tier stats in PGS as well. His combat sense is so excellent that he doesn't fall short compared to xwudd, and if I had to name his biggest strength, it's that his proficiency with literally every weapon is extremely high. If you ask players what their main weapons are, they would generally answer an AR/DMR combo, but this player doesn't discriminate. AR, DMR, SR, Shotgun, M249, Panzerfaust, Mortar—once he gets his hands on them, they simply turn into lethal killing machines. In particular, the accuracy of the mortars he fires is often absurdly precise, making him a figure requiring extreme caution. If China wins this tournament, tiantian will likely be standing at the vanguard.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/bTR4ce9N.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[KISS the Trophy - Thailand][/b][/p][p]The recent momentum of the Thai teams is unusual. Just last year, FULL SENSE (hereafter FS) won PGC 2025, and in 2026 PGS, Made in Thailand (hereafter MiTH) won twice. Perhaps because of this, looking at the lineup of this Thai representative team, you can see it is composed of terrifying players. Having achieved good results in PNC, they have caught the perfect opportunity to relieve their past sorrows.[/p][p]Thailand's best long-range shooter, Belmoth, showcased outstanding mechanics in last year's PGC. When the matches ended, he led the team to the championship, was selected as the final MVP, and became the owner of the Porsche everyone coveted. Because he delivered massive performances at crucial phases, possesses exceptionally brilliant shooting skills, and is equipped with composure, he has joined the Thai representative team for the first time in a while since his selection in 2022.[/p][p]TiGGER is a player with the world's best aggressive tendencies. He is adept at catching other combat events during a match, often inflating his explosive stats through hit-and-run tactics. Furthermore, his close-quarters infighting skills are so outstanding that if this player's knock feed pops up nearby, every team must put their guard on high alert.[/p][p]When weighing the contributions to MiTH winning this 2026 PGS 6, Scappy's share is substantial. His indoor defense is a masterpiece, and because he pursues plays entirely free of greed, he ranked 2nd overall in survival time, becoming the epitome of stability. He is expected to properly fulfill the role of Thailand's final gatekeeper.[/p][p]Since two FS members who led the PGC victory last year and two MiTH members who are showing a fantastic start in '26 have joined forces, expectations are high. However, because FS's performance this year hasn't been great, the key is whether they can overcome the main players of other teams that have generally leveled up. Additionally, since the macro directions of their respective teams are distinctly different, it will be interesting to see how this team bridges that gap.[/p][p][b]ACE - KISS
[/b]A perfect hexagon player who combines flawless infighting, innate combat sense, pressure plays through throwing setups, and composure on the big stage, along with deep respect for his teammates. If I had to pick just one player currently recording the highest stock value, it would probably be Thailand's Best Gunner, KISS.[/p][p]From his debut, this player's skills have been extraordinary. He frequently ambushed and assassinated from spots enemies never expected, and the victims were mostly top-class players with world-class mechanics. Being where he shouldn't be, and not being where he should be, leaves the victims completely helpless.[/p][p]This player is scary when roaming alone, but is far trickier when playing with the strict backup of his teammates. Not only does he rarely go down even under heavy fire, but he plays while precisely recognizing the angles from which his teammates can support him, allowing him to pour his focus entirely into one place. Going a step further, he perfectly pictures the structures and covers of buildings in his head while playing, making his throwing accuracy ghost-like.[/p][p]You want to know his weakness? Unless Thailand's team play completely breaks down, or KISS gets a stomachache on match day and his condition severely drops, this player shows no weaknesses. If you want to win this PNC 2026, you must crush Thailand's Best Gunner, KISS. If not, you will find yourselves watching KISS literally kissing the PNC trophy.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/nhqVf10A.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The Golden Star of PNC - Vietnam][/b][/p][p]PNC until now has been a continuous chaos where no one knew who would win. There was even a time when a team won by a hair's breadth of 1 point. Even when the point gap was large, it was around 30 points. But 2025 was different. The point difference between 1st and 2nd place was a staggering 61 points. It was a truly overwhelming gap. No one could bring them to their knees. Both their macro and their combat were close to perfect. The defending champions of PNC: Vietnam.[/p][p]Since participating in PNC, the Vietnam team has never dropped outside the top 4. Vietnam team's legendary coach, DjChip, remains. Moreover, not a single player out of those who lifted the PNC 2025 trophy has changed. Excluding TanVuu, 4 members including the coach currently belong to the same team, Anyone's Legend, and considering Captain Delwyn's previous home team, it's safe to say they are practically the same team.[/p][p]This team's macro is simple. Captain and main IGL, Delwyn, preoccupies a good spot, and the teammates prefer the method of clearing the outskirts with raw power before joining up. If there is a unique trait to this player, it is his outstanding ability to develop positions or rotation routes that others rarely use, and even if he dies early, his post-death shotcalling is so good that it immensely helps his teammates grasp the battlefield. He is undeniably the world's best brain.[/p][p]TanVuu is a player building the ultimate career, winning PGC in 2024 and PNC in 2025. Being able to attach a star to the Vietnam uniform came from this player's incredible survival instincts and combat sense. Hanging alone on a Miramar cliff, wiping out countless enemies, and personally eliminating the fiercely pursuing South Korean team—that player is TanVuu. In fact, during the last PNC 2025, he proved he is an exceptional player by securing 1st place in total kills and 2nd place in total survival time, competing for the final MVP with Vietnam's greatest superstar, Himass.[/p][p]Recently, Solozy has also been raising his momentum in the 2026 PGS, with his condition peaking. This player's strength is his high understanding of all weapons and his flawless, clean movements. He utilizes mortars and Panzerfausts at the perfect times, taking on the role of carving out a path for the team, and his success rate is phenomenal.[/p][p]However, looking at their recent match records in 2026 PGS, some inconsistent fluctuations have occurred, so the rivals facing the Vietnam team must not miss the flow to push forward. They must absolutely not give this team the moment to regain their rhythm. The moment you give them an opening, you will not be able to stop the Vietnam team, equipped with explosive combat power and smart macro abilities.[/p][p][b]ACE - Himass
[/b]This player can be called the icon and superstar of Vietnam. In his 4th PNC appearance, Himass possesses the qualities to become the greatest player of all time. He overcomes numerically disadvantageous situations with his own combat sense, and in particular, his AR first-bullet accuracy is so razor-sharp that he rarely loses in AR head-to-head duels. During PNC 2025, in order to eliminate just Himass left on a balcony, four German representatives rushed him, only to almost get wiped out themselves. In terms of sheer AR skill alone, I'd bet he easily ranks in the top five globally. Furthermore, because this player is also excellent at shooting the Lynx AMR, dropping your guard just because it's long-range can blow up the match itself.[/p][p]Now, the Vietnam team is eyeing the South Korean team, which holds the record of two PNC championship wins. But can they really stop this player by sheer force? If they fail to stop this Vietnamese monster, they will just have to watch as a second star gets engraved on the red uniform.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/d250WXzZ.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Spear, Shield, Commander, Captain - South Korea][/b][/p][p]There is a team that secured runner-up in 2019, 4th place in 2022, won in 2023, and secured back-to-back championships in 2024. However, in 2025, they finished in 8th place, failing to achieve the massive milestone of three consecutive championships. The National Representative Selection Committee was formed once again, picking the best players. This is the South Korea team.[/p][p]What they considered the most important in this South Korea team selection was balance. First, they needed the sharpest spear to neutralize other teams at the absolute frontline of the battlefield. The one who took on the role of that spear was the flame-like frontline fragger of T1: Heather (Ji-hoon Cha).[/p][p]From around his debut, Heather is a player who has produced countless highlight reels and boasts a high win rate even in 1vsMany fights. He quickly grasps the advantage/disadvantage of a fight, never missing a setup that favors him, and being proficient in all weapons, if you leave it to him, he has the ability to wipe out an entire squad in an instant. Even compared side-by-side with the aces of other regions mentioned above, he is a player who lacks absolutely nothing. Despite his young age, born in just 2005, his ability to never shrink on the big stage is also considered a strength.[/p][p]If you have a spear boasting sharp offensive power, you can't be without a shield, right? Across all players globally, Heaven (Tae-sung Kim) has the least variance in performance, is considered the ultimate hexagon player, and was the leading figure in the two PNC championships. It is hard to find him in poor condition, and he showcases legendary performances every time he competes.[/p][p]Ironically, when this player shines the brightest is when the team is in a critical crisis. It's no wonder he earned the nickname "South Korea's Best Shield." Whether it's throwables, close-range, or long-range, he plans to protect his teammates with his heavy shots and blinding clutch saves.[/p][p]Next, a commander was needed to tune the overall flow of the match. Consistently delivering results in international matches, and possessing a career unmatched by anyone at the domestic level, the main IGL of DN Soopers (DNS), Gyumin (Gyu-min Shim), was the perfect fit.[/p][p]Gyumin excels at accurately reading the situations of other teams and proposing the team's next scenario. Not only that, but he also frequently displays outstanding combat abilities—a crucial virtue for modern main IGLs. Holding his breath, he accurately sprayed AR first bullets to take down countless players. He is a talent equipped with both brawn and brains.[/p][p]And, of course, there had to be a Captain to tie the South Korean players together. A whopping 9 years since his debut. Born in '95. Age is just a number. Even at this very moment, he is still growing: SeongJang (Jung-hwan Seong) took the captain's armband.[/p][p]SeongJang's greatest strengths are his tuning and throwing abilities. When the main IGL ponders and selects among multiple scenarios in a match, he has the insight to modify it so that it becomes the ultimate best scenario, and his perfect throwing abilities forged by 3rd-person play make impossible breaches possible. He is also adept at grasping the surrounding combat situations, making his Kill Steal (KS) abilities exceptional.[/p][p]While their overall raw combat power might lag slightly behind other regions, considering their ability to read the situation and flow at crucial moments, the overall fighting power of the South Korea team looks second to none. I'm curious about the final result of the South Korea team boasting perfect balance.[/p][p][b]ACE - Heaven
[/b]If we only look at flashiness or super plays within a match, players from other regions might look more dazzling. But at the most perilous moments, the player who made a collapsing team hold on and eventually stand back up was always Heaven. The reason the South Korea team could attach two stars. At the center of it, he always stood. A player who has silently proven himself through his gameplay for the team's victory. South Korea's Guardian Deity, Heaven, is now looking toward a third star that no one has ever reached.[/p][p][b]Conclusion[/b][/p][p]What kind of tournament is PNC to you? To some, it might just be a simple event match. But heading into a match carrying the expectations, pride, and honor of countless fans cheering for you is not a common occurrence. Some step onto the battlefield to write a new history, some to reclaim lost glory, and others to prove their own value. This once-in-a-lifetime moment. In this historic scene, whose journey will you cheer for?[/p][p][i]- Jisuboy[/i][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: The PUBG Nations Cup 2026 kicks off with Survival Stage Day 1!
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]The PUBG Nations Cup 2026 kicks off with Survival Stage Day 1![/b][/h2][p]PNC 2026 will take place from June 23rd to June 28th in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Across five days of competition, 24 teams will battle for national pride and a share of the $500,000 base prize pool, further boosted by crowdfunding.[/p][p]
Survival Stage Participants[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p]Argentina[/p][/td][td][p]Australia[/p][/td][td][p]Canada[/p][/td][td][p]Denmark[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Finland[/p][/td][td][p]United Kingdom[/p][/td][td][p]India[/p][/td][td][p]Japan[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Kazakhstan[/p][/td][td][p]Malaysia[/p][/td][td][p]Neutral Team[/p][/td][td][p]Norway[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Philippines[/p][/td][td][p]Chinese Taipei[/p][/td][td][p]Turkiye[/p][/td][td][p]Ukraine[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]PNC 2026 will be played across two stages — the Survival Stage and the Grand Finals — with 5 matches per day.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: 2 days / 10 matches total[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 3 days / 15 matches total[/p][/*][/list][p]Of the 24 competing teams, the top 8 from PNC 2025 will begin their journey directly in the Grand Finals, while the remaining 16 teams will battle for 8 Grand Finals slots during the Survival Stage.
[/p][h3][b]\[Grand Finals – 8 Teams][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Defending Champion: Vietnam[/p][/*][*][p]Brazil, China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand, United States of America[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Survival Stage – 16 Teams][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, India, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 8 teams from the Survival Stage will join the Grand Finals to form a final field of 16 teams. The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[Map Order][/b][/h3][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Competitive Settings Update][/b][/h3][p]To deliver a more compact and fast-paced match flow, PNC 2026 will be played with adjusted Blue Zone settings.[/p][list][*][p]Shorter early Blue Zone phases: reduced duration for Phases 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter final Blue Zone phase: reduced duration for Phase 9[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of Land Ratio option: Land Ratio option has been disabled for Phases 4 and 8[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted circle size: overall reduction in circle radius to match the shorter match length[/p][/*][/list][p]These adjustments will apply to the PNC 2026 competitive environment and are expected to deliver an even more dynamic and exciting match flow.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Prize Pool & Crowdfunding[/b][/h3][p]PNC 2026 kicks off with a base prize pool of $500,000. 25% of the revenue from the PNC 2026 Event Pass, set to launch alongside the tournament, will be added to the total prize pool through crowdfunding, helping make PNC 2026 an even more rewarding stage for all participating teams.
[/p][p]The total prize pool will be distributed according to each team's final ranking, and both the prize money and sales revenue share will be distributed equally among each team's roster. Further details on the Event Pass, including release schedule and lineup, will be shared in a separate announcement.
[/p][p]* The Event Pass is not available on Console.
[/p][p]** However, 25% of the individual sales revenue from items included in the Event Pass will be added to the crowdfunding total in the same manner.
[/p]

[p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/gkOC94XN.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][/p][p]The first half of the 2026 PGS is already nearing its end. With various teams taking turns claiming the championship, I’d like to introduce three teams considered the absolute strongest title contenders. Let's take a clear look at each team's unique traits, strengths, and weaknesses.[/p][p][/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/FbtZ2p21.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][b]\[The God of War / Natus Vincere][/b][/p][p]"Born to Win." Living up to their name, Natus Vincere (NAVI) is a team that fears no fight. They don't mind disadvantageous terrain or setups; they overcome it all through sheer combat, eventually pulling off victories that give viewers an electrifying thrill. Led by their ace Hakatory, the roster includes boost1k- (who debuted last year and became Europe's rising star), spyrro (a foundational veteran of PUBG esports), and Feyerist (handling team coordination and backup). Together, they are making massive waves in the 2026 PUBG esports scene.[/p][p]There are countless moments that highlight NAVI's overwhelming combat prowess, but the most iconic would be 2026 PGS 2, where they pulled off a dramatic comeback championship from the brink. The back-to-back Chicken Dinners in Match 9 (Taego) and Match 10 (Miramar) are prime examples of them winning through absolute dominance. In Match 9 on Taego, they crushed a full-squad Anyone's Legend (AL) with just three players. In the final Match 10 on Miramar, despite a 13-point deficit behind the frontrunner AL, they once again used just three players to wipe out other teams, taking an 18-kill Chicken Dinner and carving out a historic comeback victory themselves.[/p][p]This team's strength is clear-cut: their gunplay is simply unbelievable. In terms of pure combat ability, it's safe to say almost no one can match their main roster. Hakatory, mentioned earlier, is the team's absolute core. To put it simply, even Twisted Minds' xmpl, who was revered by all players until '25, has to take a backseat to Hakatory considering recent stats. He secured a staggering 9 Man of the Match titles across the '26 PGS events and even took the Kill Leader title in PGS 5, building an untouchable legacy.[/p][p]Their team stats are just as stellar. Usually, teams that hit over 900 DPM (Damage Per Match) are the ones lifting the trophies. Over 45 matches in the '26 PGS Final Stage, NAVI recorded 45,323 total damage, hitting a DPM of 1,007. While damage isn't always the most highlighted metric, NAVI's true value shines in how they consistently stack damage to pry open opportunities.[/p][p]Most engagements start with Hakatory opening fire. From there, NAVI's primary win condition is leveraging numerical advantages to crush the opposition. Hakatory's combat ability is so overwhelming that he can often take down 2 to 3 players in a row by himself. But that's also their biggest double-edged sword: if Hakatory is picked off early, their win rate isn't great. Recently, however, spyrro and boost1k- have been putting up such aggressive performances that they're offsetting that weakness, making the team an even more terrifying unit.[/p][p]The moment you engage this team, you have to fight with the mindset of risking a full wipe. They are undoubtedly the most dreaded team to face. Your only real chance is to focus fire the exact moment they take damage. If you're aiming for the championship, you absolutely cannot miss the split second NAVI wavers. But what if NAVI stays on their feet until the very end? Well, quietly dropping a frag grenade at your own feet might be one way out.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/6jA1Gwje.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The Master of Rotation / Virtus.pro][/b][/p][p]If I had to pick just one team that best understands the fundamental rules of PUBG, I would choose this team without hesitation. Clean, flawless plays, refreshing survival strategies tailored to every situation, rotations that erase the opponents' options one by one, and a display of maximum capacity in everything needed to survive. That is Virtu[u][url="http://virtus.pro/"]s.pro(VP).[/url][/u][/p][p]Of course, VP wasn't perfect from the start. Before winning 26 PGS 3, they tasted the bitterness of consecutive Final Stage eliminations in PGS 1 and 2. However, they consistently stacked data to figure out other teams' paths. They developed ways to stabilize their roster and perfected their "first aid kit" strategy for when their squad was crippled, pushing their survival time to the extreme limit. The average survival time for a tournament-winning team is usually around 24 minutes, but across 35 matches, VP recorded a whopping 25 minutes and 56 seconds per match.[/p][p]The Taego match that epitomizes VP's survival drama shows just how meticulous and calculating this team is. With the final circle ending inside a building, they recognized their positional disadvantage against 4AM, who had already taken the roof. Deciding they couldn't win a head-on fight, they prepared Level 3 and 2 Jammer Packs. Tanking massive Blue Zone damage and outlasting everyone to take the Chicken Dinner was a scene that showcased the very essence of PUBG.[/p][p]On top of that, VP is the most strategic user of Gliders among international teams. The hardest part for edge teams rotating inward is spotting hidden ambushes. VP solves this by using Gliders to scout for ambushes before moving in, maximizing their squad's preservation. They were also the first team to attempt a Glider drop strategy in an international tournament. Although they lost that Rondo match, it was a moment that showed VP's brilliant quick-thinking and creativity.[/p][p]Add to that their decision-making ability to instantly lock down the battlefield and cut off other teams' options. A prime example is the Miramar match in PGS 5 Final Stage D1 M2. They completely shut down the entry routes of T1 and Petrichor Road pushing up from the south, simultaneously ruining 4AM's plans to third-party the fight, resulting in a flawless Chicken Dinner. VP doesn't just sit and wait for the circle; they have the ability to proactively design the situation.[/p][p]I've focused heavily on their survival and strategy, but does that mean they lack firepower? During their 26 PGS 3 championship run, across 15 matches, they averaged 5.9 kills per match, 16,993 total damage, and a DPM of 1,132. By bringing renowned fighting teams to their knees, they proved their combat prowess is entirely intact. While they prefer simple, practical techniques in fights, they also show trendy mechanics depending on the situation, proving their individual skills are highly solid.[/p][p]Armed with diverse strategies and judgments to outlive anyone, VP will remain a complex puzzle in the minds of every participating team. While other teams are busy trying to solve that puzzle, VP will only grow more solid. They might just be the first to lift their second PGS trophy.[img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/X0zrIbnE.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][b]
\[The Standard / 17Gaming][/b][/p][p]Everyone expected them to fail under those circumstances. Many said it was impossible because their core roster couldn't play together. A coach in his forties had to inevitably fill the void, and just as many predicted, the team was pushed to the absolute edge in the Survival Stage.[/p][p]But defying concerns, Coach Akuma filled the gap to secure a ticket to the Final Stage, and once their starting players returned for the finals, they went all the way to win 26 PGS 5. This is the story of China's PUBG powerhouse, 17Gaming.[/p][p]Hearing just the intro might make it sound like a dramatic movie, but if you look closely at the matches, 17Gaming didn't really change much. They simply moved to good positions at the right times, maintained the spots they usually favored but with added stability, and flawlessly demonstrated their world-class grenade usage. If there was a difference, it was maybe using a bit more smokes than usual. 17Gaming simply plays the game by the book.[/p][p]17Gaming doesn't use dramatic fights like NAVI or eccentric strategies like VP, but they always make the best possible move in every situation. Unexpected variables are bound to happen in this game, and maintaining cold logic through all of it is not easy. But China's greatest mastermind, Lilghost, makes composed yet profound decisions.[/p][p]The Rondo match in Final Stage D1 M4 serves as a perfect example. A Test Track circle popped, setting up a classic do-or-die scenario. 17 Gaming constantly looked for gaps to push inward while swatting away teams on the edge. They meticulously checked the kill feed, attempting entry based entirely on hard information.[/p][p]When MiTH, who was playing the outer fields, got wiped while forcing a push onto NAVI's in-circle compound, NAVI also failed to keep their squad intact. 17Gaming, who had been eyeing that exact spot, walked right in without shedding a drop of blood. Even DNS, who held a favorable late-game circle, saw their solid defensive line crumble from a single Lilghost frag grenade. 17Gaming followed up with continuous nades to wipe DNS, fended off all remaining teams, and took the Chicken Dinner.[/p][p]Usually, teams that deal over 17 damage per grenade get good results in tournaments. Across 30 Final Stage matches, 17Gaming threw 309 frag grenades, dealing a total of 5,828 damage. Doing the math, that’s an average of 18.86 damage per nade. Such incredible stats are partly due to the players' mechanical skill, but mostly because the shot-calling on exactly where to focus those throws is crystal clear.[/p][p]Furthermore, their play of holding the edge, burning as much time as possible, and watching for the perfect spot before moving in has become noticeably smoother than in the past. Built on that strategy, they managed to grab two Chicken Dinners on Taego in a single day. At the center of that secret was the rediscovery of the Porter, a vehicle rarely utilized on Taego.[/p][p]The Porter's cargo capacity is 400. Even if you only packed smoke grenades (weight 14), you could fit a whopping 28 of them. Not only that, but when you load items into the trunk, physical boxes actually appear in the back, providing cover from bullets. Of course, it's hard to drive and keeping the tires safe is tough, but in this PGS 5, 17Gaming successfully loaded the Porter with various supplies and utilized it until the very end of their Taego matches.[/p][p]The players' individual forms are also top-tier. Xwudd, the best gunner in the mid-range, along with tiantian and Wenbo—newly acquired from CTG this year—blended into the team so naturally it feels like they’ve always been there. With everyone's mechanics peaking, it looks incredibly difficult for anyone to gain the upper hand against 17 Gaming. The standard does not waver easily.[/p][p][b]Conclusion[/b][/p][p]If you've read this far, one question probably comes to mind.[/p][p]So, who’s going to win?[/p][p]There are no absolutes in PUBG. Predictions can always miss the mark, and new variables can always emerge. Nevertheless, at this very moment, I pick Natus Vincere, Virtus.pro, and 17Gaming as the absolute strongest contenders.[/p][p]Data doesn't lie. The results and metrics built up across countless matches ultimately prove who the strong teams are. And if the current momentum holds, it’s highly likely that the PGS 6 trophy will end up in the arms of one of these three teams.[/p][p]Whether my prediction hits the mark... we'll ultimately find the answer on the battlegrounds of PGS 6.[/p][p]- Jisooboy[/p]

newsitems.title: Community Survey — Share Your Feedback With Us
newsitems.author: TecK
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello players,[/p][p]We are running a new [b]PUBG Community Survey[/b], and we would like to hear directly from you.[/p][p][/p][p]This survey is about your experience with PUBG community channels, such as Steam Forums, Discord, Reddit, and other places where you follow news, share feedback, ask questions, or interact with other players.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to better understand what matters most to players in different regions, what you feel is working well, and where you think we can improve. This includes topics such as communication, community team presence, responses to player concerns, local language support, moderation, community activities, and how well player feedback is being heard.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback will help us improve the way we support and communicate with the PUBG community going forward.[/p][p]As a thank you for participating, we will select [b]50 players[/b] who complete the survey by [b]June 12, 2026[/b] to receive [b]1,000 G-Coin[/b] each.[/p][p][/p][p]Take the survey here:

newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]As PGS Circuit 2 approaches, the 12 Global Partner Teams and 12 PGS invited teams return to Seoul for the next chapter of PUBG Esports competition. newsitems.title: PUBG Nations Cup 2026 Tournament Details
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans![/p][p]In our previous announcement, we shared the dates and the participating nations for the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026). In this announcement, we'll walk you through the tournament format, ruleset, and other key details of the event. Let's take a closer look at PUBG Esports' biggest all-star showdown, where 24 national teams will gather on one stage.[/p][p][b]PUBG Nations Cup 2026[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 will take place from June 23rd to June 28th in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Across five days of competition, 24 national teams will battle for national pride and a share of the $500,000 base prize pool, further boosted by crowdfunding.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: June 23rd – 24th / PUBG Seongsu[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: June 26th – 28th / Jangchung Arena, Seoul[/p][/*][/list][p]All matches are scheduled to begin at 19:00 KST / 10:00 UTC / 12:00 CEST / 17:00 ICT / 03:00 PDT each day. Further details on ticket sales and on-site events will be shared on the PUBG ESPORTS website in the coming weeks.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/659bf6c7733ba6a03e2325102d75d30bf241f851.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tournament Format[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 will be played across two stages — the Survival Stage and the Grand Finals — with 5 matches per day.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: 2 days / 10 matches total[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 3 days / 15 matches total[/p][/*][/list][p]Of the 24 competing teams, the top 8 from PNC 2025 will advance directly to the Grand Finals, while the remaining 16 teams will begin their journey from the Survival Stage.[/p][p][b]\[Grand Finals – 8 Teams][/b][/p][list][*][p]Defending Champion: Vietnam[/p][/*][*][p]Brazil, China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand, United States of America[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Survival Stage – 16 Teams][/b][/p][list][*][p]Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, India, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 8 teams from the Survival Stage will join the Grand Finals to form a final field of 16 teams. The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Map Order][/b][/p][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Miramar → Erangel → Rondo → Taego → Miramar[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Miramar → Erangel → Rondo → Taego → Miramar[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Competitive Settings Update][/b][/p][p]To deliver a more compact and fast-paced match flow, PNC 2026 will be played with adjusted Blue Zone settings.[/p][list][*][p]Shorter early Blue Zone phases: reduced duration for Phases 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter final Blue Zone phase: reduced duration for Phase 9[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of Land Ratio option: Land Ratio option has been disabled for Phases 4 and 8[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted circle size: overall reduction in circle radius to match the shorter match length[/p][/*][/list][p]These adjustments will apply to the PNC 2026 competitive environment and are expected to deliver an even more dynamic and exciting match flow.[/p][p][b]Prize Pool & Crowdfunding[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 kicks off with a base prize pool of $500,000. 25% of the revenue from the PNC 2026 Event Pass, set to launch alongside the tournament, will be added to the total prize pool through crowdfunding, helping make PNC 2026 an even more rewarding stage for all participating teams.
The total prize pool will be distributed according to each team's final ranking, and both the prize money and sales revenue share will be distributed equally among each team's roster. Further details on the Event Pass, including release schedule and lineup, will be shared in a separate announcement.[/p][p]* The Event Pass is not available on Console.[/p][p]** However, 25% of the individual sales revenue from items included in the Event Pass will be added to the crowdfunding total in the same manner.[/p][p]Stay updated on all things PUBG Nations Cup 2026 by following the PUBG Esports website and our official social channels.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: PNC 2026 Official Participating Teams Announcement
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans![/p][p]In our previous announcements, we shared the schedule and participating teams for the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026). At last, we're excited to officially unveil the rosters of all 24 all-star teams set to take the stage in Seoul this June![/p][p]96 all-star players and 24 coaches will compete for the title of world's best — meet the full lineup taking the PNC 2026 stage below.[/p][h2]PNC 2026 Official Rosters[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ed758870174d1ca307288fdddf4cf3c3364a97fe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/34b2eac02cf69fa7138f52c34caa95ca92d7ec95.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f1c2f2ff7f3d248cdd52d6efda7bf1f3f1ad41d1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a6d4f4a48c6a01b6022761247d676974d87dadaf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/690ec8aafdd374160522a6ef667edb693045298c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1eb57c9c90569a294a28e1082b740a6a8d09ea1a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Storylines to Watch at PNC 2026[/h2][h3]Return of the Champions[/h3][p]Since the very first PUBG Nations Cup in 2019, only four teams have ever lifted the PNC trophy. This year, 10 of those past champions return to the PNC 2026 stage.[/p][list][*][p][b]The First PNC Champion (2019): ADOUZ1E[/b] returns to the PNC stage for the first time in seven years.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNC 2022 Champion[/b] — [b]United Kingdom[/b]: The full championship lineup is back together. Vard, Fexx, TeaBone, and mykLe reunite under head coach MiracU.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNC 2023 & PNC 2024 Back-to-Back Champion[/b] — [b]South Korea[/b]: Heaven stands alone as the only player in the PNC 2026 field with two PNC titles to his name.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNC 2025 Defending Champion — Vietnam[/b]: The defending champion's title-winning roster returns intact — Himass, TanVuu, Delwyn, and Sololzy, with head coach DjChip back to lead the title defense.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Three Players Who've Never Missed a PNC[/h3][p]Since the first PUBG Nations Cup in 2019, only three players have appeared at every single edition.[/p][list][*][p][b]Vard [/b]— United Kingdom, Construction Workers[/p][/*][*][p][b]ItzzChrizZ [/b]— Germany, ACEND Club[/p][/*][*][p][b]luke12 [/b]— Australia, Team Liquid[/p][/*][/list][p]PNC 2026 will be their[b] sixth PNC[/b].[/p][p]One more name belongs alongside them. [b]Chinese Taipei's head coach Leo[/b] competed as a player in every PNC from 2019 to 2025. This year, he returns as a head coach — the same uninterrupted record, a new role at the table.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Happy Early Birthday, Mikzenn[/h3][p]On June 27, Denmark's Mikzenn (Patrick Pagh Christensen) will celebrate his 24th [b]birthday [/b]on the PNC 2026 Grand Finals stage — the only player in the 96-player field whose birthday falls within the tournament window.[/p][p]An early [b]happy birthday [/b]from PUBG Esports![/p][p] [/p][h3]Yesterday's Teammates, Today's Rivals[/h3][p]This is the magic that only PNC can deliver. Players who share a practice room and a roster jersey all year round suddenly find themselves on opposite sides of the same lobby — facing off against the very people they call teammates the rest of the year.[/p][p]This year, [b]Team Falcons [/b]sends 5 representatives to PNC 2026, split across [b]3 different teams[/b] — and three of them lead their squads as captains.[/p][list][*][p][b]TGLTN [/b]— Captain of Australia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gustav [/b]— Captain of Denmark[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shrimzy [/b](Captain), Kickstart, head coach GUNNER — United States[/p][/*][/list][p]One org, three teams. The Falcons family will meet in Seoul this June — and from the moment they drop into the same lobby, they'll be marking each other first.[/p][p] [/p][p]Stay tuned for further updates on PNC 2026 via the official PUBG Esports website and our social channels.[/p][p]A five-day showdown of the world's best all-star teams is coming to Seoul this June — we can't wait to see you at PUBG Nations Cup 2026![/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Squads up. We are running our first Crew Clash this Saturday with Rumble!
newsitems.author: TecK
newsitems.contents: [p]This is the first time we are testing this community format, so the goal is simple: bring crews together, see how squads respond to Rumble, collect useful feedback, and decide whether this should become a regular weekend activity.[/p][p][/p][p]Rumble is a weekend-limited casual competitive mode where pre-made 4-player crews can test their teamwork without the pressure of Ranked tier losses. You still get the tension, the leaderboard chase, and the rewards![/p][p][/p][p][b]⌚ This week’s Rumble window[/b][/p][list][*][p]Saturday, May 23rd[/p][/*][*][p]20:00 - 00:00 (regional local time)[/p][list][*][p]Available in NA & EU[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b] 💭 How to join[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play Rumble during the Saturday window[/p][/*][*][p]Submit your [b]result screensho[/b]t after playing on our [url="https://discord.gg/4Prp35bU"]Discord server[/url].[/p][/*][*][p]Give us some feedback about the mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]✍️ Example Post[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ingame Names: TecK, Kruskay, 0reeoo & xFlow[/p][/*][*][p]Rumble Region: EU[/p][/*][*][p]Feedback: Competing against other players was fun, but I would like to see XYZ changed and have it available on Sunday as well.[/p][/*][*][p]+ attached screenshot[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🪙 Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Highest ranked crew: [b]3000 G-Coin[/b] each player[/p][/*][*][p]10x random participating crews: [b]500 G-Coin[/b] each player[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🗒️ Important Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can submit your results untilMonday, 25 May 2026 at 09:00 CEST.[/p][/*][*][p]Once your crew is signed up in Rumble, you cannot change crew members, switch crews, or participate in Rumble in a different region during that stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Rumble is played as Squad TPP Normal Matches on Erangel, Taego, Miramar, or Rondo, selected at random.[/p][/*][*][p]Top crews are ranked by accumulated score from placement, survival time, and kills. Rankings update every 5 minutes, and final rankings are determined 2 hours after the Rumble stage ends.[/p][/*][*][p]G-Coin rewards won on Discord will be sent directly to your account within 7 days after the end of this event.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: PUBG Global Championship 2026 Heads to İstanbul, Türkiye!
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p]The most prestige stage of the year, the PUBG Global Championship 2026 (PGC 2026), runs from December 1 (Tue) to December 13 (Sun) in İstanbul, Türkiye.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"]Thirty-two teams from around the world will compete across nine match days for a $1,500,000+ prize pool and the title of PUBG Esports global champion. Fan-driven crowdfunding will add to the prize pool, with additional rewards going to the top-performing teams.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][h1][b]PGC 2026 Overview[/b][/h1][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/Od3eKaLo.png"][/img][/b][/p][list][*][p]Location: İstanbul, Türkiye[/p][/*][*][p]Dates: December 1 (Tue) – December 13 (Sun), 2026[/p][/*][*][p]Teams: 32[/p][/*][*][p]Prize Pool: $1,500,000 (+ crowdfunding)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]A New Qualification Path[/b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/CIwQcuLd.png"][/img][/h2][p align="start"]For PGC 2026, each team's starting stage is determined by their results across PGS and regional leagues throughout the season. Unlike previous seasons where all teams began from a shared Group Stage, top-seeded teams will skip earlier stages and enter the tournament at a later point.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/4SqeIax6.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/FtbEQkUf.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]There are three entry paths to PGC 2026:[/p][list][*][p]Grand Finals Direct Invite — 8 teams[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage Day 1 Direct — 8 teams[/p][/*][*][p]Qualifying Stage Entry — 16 teams[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This tiered structure rewards teams that performed well throughout the season with a stronger starting position at PGC, and raises the stakes for every match across the regional leagues and PGS leading up to the global stage.[/p][p align="start"]Note: If a team qualifies for PGC through both PGS points and a regional league, the higher-stage qualification takes precedence. When both qualifications correspond to the same stage, PGS points take priority. Any seed that goes unused due to double qualification is removed and reallocated to the next-in-line team in that region's PGC points standings.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Regional Seed Allocation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Global Seeds (PGS) — 8 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Americas (PAS) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]China (PCL) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]EMEA (PEC) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Korea (PWS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Rest of APAC (PMS) — 2 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Thailand (PTS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Vietnam (PVS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Wildcard — 1 slot[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The Wildcard slot will go to a team representing Türkiye, the host region for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The tournament consists of three phases: [b]Qualifying Stage, Survival Stage[/b], and [b]Grand Finals.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/mMT0z8lu.png"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Qualifying Stage — December 1 (Tue)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The 16 Qualifying Stage seeds compete on the opening day.[/p][p align="start"]The top 8 advance to Survival Stage Day 1, while the remaining 8 move to Survival Stage Day 2.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage — December 2 (Wed) – December 6 (Sun)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Survival Stage runs across five days, with 16 teams competing each day.[/p][p align="start"]From Day 1 through Day 4, the team with the highest combined match score on each day secures a direct ticket to the Grand Finals — one per day, four teams in total.[/p][p align="start"]On the final day, the top 16 teams by cumulative points across Days 1 through 4 compete for the last four Grand Finals spots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Grand Finals — December 11 (Fri) – December 13 (Sun)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Grand Finals span three days with a total of 15 matches (five per day). The final standings and the year's global champion will be decided here.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Grand Finals Qualified Teams[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The 16 teams competing at the Grand Finals reach the stage through three paths.[/p][p align="start"][b]Grand Finals Direct Invite — 8 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]Six Regional League 1st place teams + PGS 1st place + Host Country Wildcard[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage Daily Match Winners — 4 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]One match winner from each of Survival Stage Day 1 through Day 4[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage Cumulative Top 4 — 4 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]Top 4 by total points across the entire Survival Stage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Prize Pool[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The total PGC 2026 prize pool is $1,500,000+, made up of the Ranking Prize (based on final standings) and the Special Prize (awarded for key performances during the Grand Finals).[/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/J6crpHtc.png"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Ranking Prize — $1,310,000 total[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Ranking Prize is distributed to all participating teams based on Grand Finals qualification and final standings. Minimum guaranteed payouts for teams that do not reach the Grand Finals are integrated into the same Ranking Prize structure, creating a single, unified payout system.[/p][p align="start"][b]Special Prize — $190,000 total[/b][/p][p align="start"]Additional prizes are awarded for key performances during the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Crowdfunding[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Fan-driven crowdfunding returns for PGC 2026. This season brings one notable change: crowdfunding contributions will be distributed exclusively to the Grand Finals Top 8 teams, allocated by final standing (30% to 4%).[/p][p align="start"]The more fans take part, the larger the final prize pool grows, and the greater the rewards for top-performing clubs. Details on how to participate will follow through official channels.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Closing[/b][/p][p align="start"]With this season's PGS and regional league results directly shaping each team's starting point at PGC 2026, every remaining match carries added weight. Stay tuned for the 32 teams set to compete for the title this December in İstanbul.[/p][p align="start"]Further details on PGC 2026 will follow through PUBG Esports' official channels.[/p]

newsitems.title: Vote for Your Player. Win G-Coin.
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]Player of the Day is back for PGS Circuit 2. Here's everything you need to know — including what's new this circuit.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="https://media-cdn.atlassian.com/file/97e3b562-d2f3-4dca-9647-cf2d7c6d0379/image/cdn?allowAnimated=true&client=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&collection=contentId-1046653477&height=125&max-age=2592000&mode=full-fit&source=mediaCard&token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..TRyOFyJa_uONHCs4r0BccIvu9tKv7qSB5ivKvtjTD8w&width=421#media-blob-url=true&id=97e3b562-d2f3-4dca-9647-cf2d7c6d0379&clientId=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&contextId=contentId-1046653477&collection=contentId-1046653477"][/img][/p][h2]What Is Player of the Day?[/h2][p align="start"]Player of the Day is a fan-driven spotlight program that runs during the Final Day broadcast of each tournament. While the pros battle it out on the biggest stage, you get to vote for the player who impressed you most. The player chosen by fan vote is officially recognized as the 'Player of the Day' by PUBG Esports.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Who Can Be Player of the Day?[/h2][p align="start"]There's no set formula. But Player of the Day might just be a player like this:[/p][list][*][p]The one who [b]carried[/b] the team with dominant kills and damage[/p][/*][*][p]The one who pulled off a [b]clutch[/b] play and turned the tide[/p][/*][*][p]The one who showed [b]textbook survival[/b] with sharp positioning and game sense[/p][/*][*][p]The one who [b]changed the game[/b] with creative use of grenades, Panzerfaust, BRDMs, and more[/p][/*][*][p]The one who created [b]that moment[/b] everyone's still talking about after the broadcast ends[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]These are just examples — greatness in PUBG comes in all forms. Vote for whoever left the biggest impression on you. That's all there is to it.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="https://media-cdn.atlassian.com/file/58fa990b-a640-427a-b1ce-650514ee6320/image/cdn?allowAnimated=true&client=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&collection=contentId-1046653477&height=125&max-age=2592000&mode=full-fit&source=mediaCard&token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..TRyOFyJa_uONHCs4r0BccIvu9tKv7qSB5ivKvtjTD8w&width=421#media-blob-url=true&id=58fa990b-a640-427a-b1ce-650514ee6320&clientId=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&contextId=contentId-1046653477&collection=contentId-1046653477"][/img][/p][h2]How to Participate[/h2][olist][*][p]Watch the PUBG Global Series Final Stage and Grand Finals broadcast. Player of the Day voting takes place on the Final Day of each PGS event.[/p][/*][*][p]Cast your vote. Once voting opens, a voting post will go live on the PUBG Esports website. One vote per person — pick one player from the nominees.[/p][/*][*][p]Follow the live results. Real-time vote standings are revealed during the broadcast, so you can see who's leading.[/p][/*][*][p]Check the results. After the Final, the Player of the Day will be announced through the official BATTLEGROUNDS Esports social channels.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Each Player of the Day will also be featured in dedicated post-event content, including interviews, behind-the-scenes coverage, and highlight packages.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]PGS Circuit 2 — Voting Schedule & Rewards[/h2][p align="start"]Player of the Day returns for PGS Circuit 2. Please note the updated voting window and rewards for this circuit.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="180,,,"][tr][th colwidth="180"][p]Event[/p][/th][th][p]Voting Window[/p][/th][th][p]Reward[/p][/th][th][p]Where to Vote[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="180"][p]PGS 4 Final Stage Day 2[/p][/td][td][p]May 24 (Sun) 09:00 – 12:30 UTC[/p][/td][td rowspan="3"][p]1,000 G-Coin (random draw among voters)[/p][/td][td rowspan="3"][p][url="https://pubgesports.com"]pubgesports.com[/url] \[NEWS] – \[WIDGET][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="180"][p]PGS 5 Final Stage Day 2[/p][/td][td][p]May 31 (Sun) 09:00 – 12:30 UTC[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="180"][p]PGS 6 Grand Finals Day 3[/p][/td][td][p]June 7 (Sun) 09:00 – 12:30 UTC[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]❗️ [b]The voting window has been updated this circuit.[/b] Voting now closes at 12:30 UTC — earlier than before. Make sure to cast your vote before the deadline![/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Why Player of the Day?[/h2][p align="start"]We want to shine a light not just on the champions, but on the players who make PUBG Esports an unforgettable experience through their own stories. And we want you to be part of that story. Whether it's a name you've cheered for all season or a player you discovered today — your vote puts the spotlight on them.[/p][p align="start"]Player of the Day is yours to decide. Today, who caught your eye?[/p]
